hero_subhead: The Co.LLab™ is an intellectual-property and leadership-infrastructure ecosystem — not a conventional consulting practice. This is where ideas live, research happens, theories develop, infrastructure gets built, and people collaborate.

mission_quote.text: To build leadership infrastructure that empowers people and organizations to transform
into performance, sustainable enterprise value, and lasting legacy.

vision_body_prefix: A world where infrastructure is built around human potential — rather than people being forced to conform to infrastructure that was never designed for
problem_headline: Most infrastructure is built first. Then humans are expected to adapt.
problem_body: The Co.LLab™ reverses that model. Traditional: design, deploy, train, expect adoption. Ours: understand the human, design the infrastructure, build the operating system, develop, preserve. Designing around human behavior — rather than forcing human behavior into predetermined systems — is the fundamental idea behind everything here.
phases_eyebrow: How we work — the four-phase model

phases.title: Foundations
phases.description: Understanding the person, organization, purpose, potential, values, identity, and underlying structure.

phases.title: Infrastructure Planning & Management
phases.description: Determining what infrastructure is needed and how the pieces should connect.

phases.title: Internal Operating Systems
phases.description: Building the systems, processes, structures, tools, and leadership mechanisms that let the organization function.

phases.title: Preservation
phases.description: Making the infrastructure sustainable, transferable, scalable, and capable of creating lasting legacy.

model_headline: Not a linear funnel. Value moves in every direction.
model_body: The Co.LLab™ isn't a single-purpose consulting business. Value moves between people, ideas, infrastructure, products, organizations, community, and legacy — with multiple entry points and multiple ways to create value, each connected back to Leadership Infrastructure™.

audiences.title: Founders Organization
audiences.description: Founders building enterprises capable of growth, scale, and legacy.

audiences.title: Corporate / Enterprise
audiences.description: Organizations building infrastructure behind their leadership.

audiences.title: .LLab™ Products & Membership
audiences.description: Leaders accessing frameworks and tools directly.

audiences.title: Creator Infrastructure™
audiences.description: A future direction connecting artists and creators to the same leadership infrastructure — not yet a public offering. (In development.)

ip_headline: Ideas → Research → Theory → Framework → Infrastructure → Product → Licensing → Enterprise.
ip_body: The Co.LLab™ has accumulated frameworks, methodologies, terminology, models, research, theories, products, systems, creative IP, and educational assets. The goal isn't to hide these pieces — it's to give them a visible architecture.
personality_body: Academic without being boring. Corporate without becoming sterile. Creative without becoming chaotic. Experimental without losing credibility. Serious about ideas without taking itself too seriously. There is room for weirdness — "let's investigate this absolutely ridiculous idea and see where it goes" is part of the R.A.T.™ spirit.
community_body: The community isn't based on everyone agreeing. We can disagree, question things, explore strange ideas, and still treat each other with respect. No hate. No disrespect. This is for people who want to think, investigate, question, theorize, and build.
closing_eyebrow: The idea behind all of it
closing_body_prefix: For people. Leaders. Founders. Organizations. Artists. Creators. Enterprises. And, ultimately:
